Welcome to Pullman Sydney Penrith
Discover an ideal venue to meet, dine, stay, and experience everything that the Panthers leisure and entertainment precinct has to offer. The newly built Pullman Sydney Penrith is the region s first five-star hotel and features the incredible Western Sydney Convention Centre (WSCC), the region s largest purpose-built meeting and events centre.
On arrival to Pullman Sydney Penrith, guests are welcomed to an architecturally designed curved building inspired by the local Nepean River, which blends into the surrounding landscape. With grand ceilings and elegant finishes, guests and visitors instantly feel a sense of comfort and belonging in the lobby lounge, cafe, restaurant, and bar areas. Pullman Sydney Penrith features 152 well-appointed guest rooms and suites and offers an elite fitness centre, divine dining with an enviable wine and cocktail list as well as a bespoke sleep therapy menu.
The adjacent Western Sydney Convention Centre boasts 1,250sqm of flexible pillar-free space with wireless audio-visual capabilities, natural light, as well as a seamless flow to indoor and outdoor pre-function spaces. Pullman Sydney Penrith is located in the Panthers Leisure and Entertainment Precinct which features 11 specialty restaurants and bars, a dedicated theatre, indoor sky diving, aqua golf, cable skiing and is located across the road to Penrith s BlueBet Stadium.
With the highly anticipated opening of Western Sydney International (Nancy-Bird Walton) Airport in 2026, Pullman Sydney Penrith is the closest luxury hotel to Western Sydney International Airport, offering unmatched convenience for domestic and international travellers, conference delegates, and event organisers alike.
The team at Pullman Sydney Penrith are excited to welcome you to discover the region s first five-star hotel and convention centre, the perfect place to meet, dine, play, and stay.

Our Rooms
The rooms at Pullman Sydney Penrith offer unparalleled levels of comfort and indulgence with luxurious bedding, black-out curtains, complimentary bath robes and slippers, Hunter Lab bathroom amenities and one of the first ever Sleep Therapy Menus.
Guests can enjoy the latest technology with in-room smart tablets, over 80 Foxtel Channels with a library of over 4,000 television episodes and 1,000 complimentary movies.
Every room features complimentary bottled water refilled daily, Nespresso Coffee Makers, Minibar Fridges, In-Room Safes and indulgent TWG Teas.
Upgrade to one of our deluxe rooms to also receive hair straighteners and clothes steamers, while our suites also offer a microwave oven and residential size fridge and freezer.
We have thought of everything that you could possibly need to ensure an experience more comfortable than you could ever imagine.

Restaurants & Bars
Marcel Bar & Bistro showcases a modern and sophisticated European Bistro, famous for professional and warm service, quality local produce and a carefully curated wine list. Classic bistro food showcasing local produce and traditional techniques with contemporary flare.
Adjacent to the Bistro is our intimate wine and cocktail lounge, offering more than 150 specialty wines, bespoke cocktails and all of your favourite beverages.
If it is something more casual that you are looking for, downstairs is Tori Cafe and Bar offering AllPress Coffee, premium pastries along with a range of light meals from early morning to late evening.
